purpose: Resolve claim-level curriculum locators without duplicating progression content.

CN.method: Match concept_id to a section locator. Show learning stage and section hierarchy. Show printed page only when non-null.

UK.method: Resolve the concept from the relevant verified domain file, select the requested Year entry, and render National Curriculum in England → Year N → named programme-of-study strand. Do not label the whole UK.

US.method: Resolve the concept from the relevant verified domain file, select the requested Grade entry and render the stored standard_codes. If no Grade 1-6 Common Core standard exists, say so instead of forcing a match.

rules: A locator identifies where a claim comes from; it does not increase the verification status of the claim.
For England, keep Year labels as England Year N in Chinese output.
For Common Core, keep Grade labels as Common Core Grade N in Chinese output.
Do not invent a standard code when a research record contains only a broader domain locator.
Teaching guidance and research evidence use their own source-specific locators and must not be presented as statutory curriculum locators.
